lines.zh: 全套重甲，走一步晃三晃。
lines.en: Full plate, and every step sways.

lines.zh: 地面被我的靴子踩出印子。
lines.en: My boots leave prints in the earth.

lines.zh: 慢是慢，可谁也推不动我。
lines.en: Slow, yes. But no one pushes me aside.
I see the road through one slit.

lines.zh: 甲片叠了三层，转身要用力。
lines.en: Three layers of plate; even turning takes effort.
My pauldrons bend the grass as I pass.
Half a mile and I wheeze like a bellows.

lines.zh: 想快也快不了，钢板不答应。
lines.en: I would hurry, but the steel disagrees.
My shield nearly drags on the ground.

lines.zh: 每一步都踩实了再抬脚。
lines.en: I plant each step before lifting the next.

lines.zh: 厚重的影子先到，人后到。
lines.en: My heavy shadow arrives before I do.
My knee guards clank with every stride.

lines.zh: 站着喘气，面甲里全是雾。
lines.en: Standing and breathing; fog fills my visor.
Still as an iron bell.
Sweat runs down inside the plates.
I would sit, but I might not rise again.
Leaning on my sword, catching my breath.

lines.zh: 从头盔里看出去，世界变窄。
lines.en: Through the helm, the world narrows.

lines.zh: 对面有人，我也懒得转头。
lines.en: Someone is there; I cannot be bothered to turn.
The sun has made my steel hot.
The wind does not reach me in here.
I can hear my own heartbeat.

lines.zh: 这身甲，穿着比穿着还难脱。
lines.en: Wearing it is easier than taking it off.

lines.zh: 重甲就得站得稳，别乱动。
lines.en: Heavy armor means standing firm.
Have you looked enough? Stop staring.
Can you even cut through this much iron?

lines.zh: 别绕到我背后，我转得慢。
lines.en: Do not get behind me. I turn slowly.
Speak up. The helm muffles you.

lines.zh: 你笑得像个不知轻重的人。
lines.en: You smile like someone who does not know better.
Stand straight, let me see you.
Your weapon is too small.
Come closer. I will not dodge.
Lifting my visor takes both hands.
Do not tap my breastplate; it echoes.
One step from me blocks your way.

lines.zh: 重甲不是好看，是挨得住。
lines.en: Heavy armor is not for show. It takes hits.
The steel is dented. I am still here.
That found a gap. It really hurts.
I sway, then just barely hold.
Even heavy armor breaks. I know.
Blood pools inside the plates.
One grunt, and the sword stays.
Harder than I expected.
A plate cracks, and my heart sinks.
A breath, then I push back.
Any iron? My plates are cracked.
The smell of coal fire weakens my knees.
Good steel means more than a meal.
Are you offering to patch my armor?
The clasp on my back has come loose.
New knee guards and I could walk faster.

lines.zh: 这铁锤声，我听着走不动。
lines.en: That hammering makes me stop walking.
That iron ingot looks well smelted.
Even a drink makes me think twice.
Do not swing an iron hook in my sight.
Hit me and you bounce off.
I am a wall. Go around.
Does your shoulder not hurt, hitting iron?
Steady. This armor of mine is shifting.
Iron meets iron; my side is quiet.
Do not push from the side. I might topple.
Back off. I am lifting a foot.

lines.zh: 你的剑柄戳到我的腰甲。
lines.en: Your hilt pokes my hip plate.

lines.zh: 我这一转身要占半个走廊。
lines.en: My turn takes half the corridor.
Make way. The slow one goes first.
Unbuckling this armor takes an hour.
There is a man under the plate.
This armor was pledged to Red first.
Talk to me after this battle.
I fear I would crush the other party.

lines.zh: 媒人见我这身铁就走了。
lines.en: The matchmaker saw my armor and left.
My oath is etched inside the breastplate.
A family needs time out of the armor.
I can barely bend at the waist.
This is not mine to think about.
Bending is hard work. Slow now.
An iron nail on the ground. Mine.
I need both hands to pick it up.
The plates are too stiff for my fingers.

lines.zh: 这扣子是从我甲上掉的。
lines.en: This clasp fell off my own armor.
Pocket it; I will fix it later.
One lump of iron patches a small hole.
Do not push me while I am bent over.
Something in my back went click.

lines.zh: 营里的东西，交给军需官。
lines.en: Camp property goes to the quartermaster.

lines.zh: 慢吞吞举剑，但举起来了。
lines.en: I raise my sword slowly, but it is raised.
Target sighted. I press toward it.
Heavy armor leads. Follow.
This ground is mine to tread.
I move first. Do not get ahead.
Shield across, blocking the path.
He may run. I plug that end.

lines.zh: 重甲冲阵，就是这个用法。
lines.en: This is what heavy armor is for.

lines.zh: 给他看清面甲里的眼睛。
lines.en: Let him see the eyes inside my helm.
One step of mine plugs the door.
My steel turns to him, slow and steady.
The target is the one with the blade.
I push in. Do not scatter.
I see him clearly. No mistake.
He backs off; I do not chase fast.
I close in, inch by inch.
My breath booms inside the helm.
Ranged is fine. Two more steps.
Do not circle. I cannot turn that well.
He lifts his arm, and my shield rises.
I wait for him to tire first.
My blade tip draws a line in the dirt.
My sabaton digs a pit in the soil.
No rush. I can take this.
He is breathing harder than I am.
I press my shield lower.
Keep the weight centered; do not trip.
Watch his feet. Cut off his route.

lines.zh: 我往前一步，他就退一步。
lines.en: I step in, and he steps back.
I wait for the instant he commits.
I throw my whole weight behind a falling blade.
The shield knocks his arm aside.
My steel drives him backward.
Slow, but the blow is terrifying.
A shoulder charge breaks his guard.
He blocked it. His hands are shaking.
My plates eat his counter.

lines.zh: 一剑劈在地上，土都飞了。
lines.en: My blade bites the ground and throws dirt.
At this range he has no room.
I do not give ground. He must.
My plate grinds past his edge.
Three blows, then I shift the angle.
An elbow into his chest.
My weight drops, and the sword follows.
That one will slow him for a while.
My armor clatters as I recover.
He is backed against the wall.

lines.zh: 最后一下，用全身的力气。
lines.en: The last blow, with everything I have.

lines.zh: 铁靴落地，地面震了一下。
lines.en: My boot lands, and the ground shudders.
Red heavy armor, holding this road.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，可我会一直走。
lines.en: I am not fast, but I keep walking.

lines.zh: 套上这身甲，我就没打算退。
lines.en: Once in this armor, I do not plan to retreat.
Clear the gate; I enter slowly.

lines.zh: 甲缝里还带着锻炉的热气。
lines.en: The forge heat still lingers in my plates.
Who called for the heavy? Here I am.
First time in full plate. It weighs on me.
Shield up first. Then we talk.
This armor rings louder than the horn.

lines.zh: 我把剑插进土里当支点。
lines.en: I plant my sword in the dirt as a brace.
Once set, I do not move.
The steel heats and presses on my skin.

lines.zh: 落地时整身甲都撞响了。
lines.en: The whole suit crashes down with me.

lines.zh: 面甲里进水，我快看不见。
lines.en: Water in my visor. I can barely see.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀得单膝跪地。
lines.en: The blast drops me to one knee.
An arrow is wedged in a seam.

lines.zh: 这光穿甲而过，我没办法。
lines.en: This light passes through steel.
Heavy armor burns me out. I starve fast.
Current crawls all through my plates.

lines.zh: 铁靴下面什么都没有了。
lines.en: Nothing remains under my boots.
